brief.headline: Move from pay-on-delivery to 30-day credit and free up ₹44.91 L of our cash — they already take 63d to pay their own suppliers, so this is only fair

priceAsk.summary: No price cut this round — their profit is already thin and we're too small a customer to push hard
priceAsk.target: Hold current price but secure 30-day terms instead
priceAsk.basis: They keep 5.4% profit vs 10.2% at similar firms, so price cuts hurt them more than most. At 0.12% of their ₹4491.70 Cr revenue we have little pricing pull. Win on payment terms first, then revisit price once we have a second source qualified.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from pay-on-delivery to standard 30-day credit
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: This frees up ₹44.91 L of our cash — our strongest, simplest ask

brief.financialLeverage: They're big (₹4491.70 Cr revenue) and we're tiny (0.12% of their sales), so we have almost no weight on our own. Their cash is stuck for 75d vs 30d at similar firms, meaning cash is tight for them — they'll value faster payment. They already take 63d to pay their own suppliers vs 6d at peers, so asking for 30 days from them is only fair. They owe 1.09x their own cash (₹551.00 Cr debt) and keep thinner profit (5.4% vs 10.2%), so they need the cashflow but can't afford big price cuts. Push hard on terms, hold the line on price, and qualify a second source to get real leverage next time.

evidence.point: We pay them on delivery right now, worst terms we have
Moving to 30-day credit frees up cash for us
They already take much longer to pay their own suppliers than similar firms
Their cash is stuck longer than most
We're a tiny customer to them
They keep less profit than similar firms

risks: They're our only source for aseptic cartons (100%, ₹5.46 Cr) — until we approve a second supplier we have no fallback and weak bargaining power
22% of their deliveries get reversed or returned — fix quality and paperwork issues before they cost us more
They're in the grey zone (Altman Z 2.15) with severe legal cases flagged — watch supply stability and don't push so hard we tip a fragile supplier over
At 0.12% of their revenue we're too small to matter on our own — bundle longer commitment or more volume to get their attention, or find a credible alternate to create competitive pressure
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You take 63 days to pay your own suppliers while we pay you on delivery — let's level that: we move to 30-day terms, which frees up ₹44.91 L for us and still gets you paid faster than you pay others.
